1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __embedded within__ the test tube.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is __embedded underneath the bottom surface of__ the test tube, oriented for reading __upwards__.

6. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a MTP in plastic or comprising heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded MTP; and reading the MTP. 

8. (Currently Amended) The method of reading of claim 7, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein the vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20 C or less. 

10. (New) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer.

11. (New) The assembly of claim 10, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

12. (New) The assembly of claim 10, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom surface of the test tube, oriented for reading __upwards__.

13. (New) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

14. (New) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom surface of the test tube, oriented for reading __upwards__.
